name: neoruntime-docs
description: NeoRuntime documentation site — project wiki + bilingual Web API reference. Built with Astro Starlight + Redoc, deployed to GitHub Pages.

scripts.build: python3 scripts/build_specs.py && node scripts/copy-redoc.mjs && python3 scripts/sync_project_docs.py && astro build
scripts.dev: python3 scripts/build_specs.py && node scripts/copy-redoc.mjs && python3 scripts/sync_project_docs.py && astro dev
